scope: All ordinary body-flow citations and every canonical bibliography entry were checked for existence, metadata, direct nearby-claim support, and natural scholarly coverage. Primary publisher, arXiv, author-hosted article, and official preprint records were used. The audit does not claim priority, peer-review status for preprints, or mathematical correctness beyond the accepted mathematical audit.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage non-interactive audit: first freeze the seven manuscript claim/citation pairs and their exact key union in audit/citation-claim-ledger.json; then independently replay author/title, full-title, venue, DOI, and arXiv searches and verify each fixed claim against an exact primary-source passage recorded in audit/source-locations.json. Finally compare all seven BibTeX records with those primary records and run the canonical TeX/BibTeX key checker.
